<!-- en -->
v0.1.10 is a small feature release: a collector for Xiaomi MiMo Desktop and the MiMo Code CLI joins the supported clients, and the dashboard's range memory is narrowed to the browser tab that made the selection.

### New
- Xiaomi MiMo / MiMo Code collector (`mimocode`). One client key covers both Xiaomi MiMo Desktop and the MiMo Code CLI: the two share a single local SQLite database (default `~/.local/share/mimocode/mimocode.db`, configurable via `clients.mimocode.paths.db`), and the database carries no per-product marker, so sessions are reported under the single display name `Xiaomi MiMo / MiMo Code` rather than split. Collection follows the OpenCode/ZCode pattern: the daemon watches the database file in real time (WAL mode — the change fingerprint takes `max(db, -wal)` mtime), daemon startup catch-up uses incremental cursors, and a first full `collect all` scans the whole history without a date filter. `collect --client mimocode` and `errors --source mimocode` accept the new name, and the `client` dimension reports `Xiaomi MiMo / MiMo Code`. The client is disabled by default; CC-Switch router attribution remains Claude-family/Codex only and does not apply to it.
- Enabling and first collection. `token-usage config set clients.mimocode.enabled true` enables the client; a first `token-usage collect all --client mimocode` backfills existing history; a running daemon needs `token-usage daemon restart` to pick up the new section and start real-time monitoring.

### Fixed
- The dashboard's range selection is remembered per tab. The selection now lives in `sessionStorage` instead of `localStorage`: reloading the same tab keeps the picked range, while a newly opened page always starts from the Today default. Previously the selection persisted per origin indefinitely, so a page opened later restored stale literal dates — yesterday's Today, with no preset highlighted. This matches the documented contract ("remembered across reloads"); no action is needed — the old `localStorage` entry is simply no longer read.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.10 是一个小功能版本：新增 Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 与 MiMo Code CLI 采集器，仪表板的范围选区记忆收窄到做出选择的浏览器标签页。

### 新增
- Xiaomi MiMo / MiMo Code 采集器（`mimocode`）。一个客户端 key 覆盖 Xiaomi MiMo Desktop 与 MiMo Code CLI 两者：二者共用同一本地 SQLite 数据库（默认 `~/.local/share/mimocode/mimocode.db`，经 `clients.mimocode.paths.db` 配置），库内无产品区分标记，因此会话统一记在单一显示名 `Xiaomi MiMo / MiMo Code` 下、不拆分。采集沿用 OpenCode/ZCode 模式：daemon 实时监控该数据库文件（WAL 模式——变更指纹取 `max(db, -wal)` mtime），daemon 启动 catch-up 走增量游标，首次 `collect all` 全量扫描历史、不带日期过滤。`collect --client mimocode` 与 `errors --source mimocode` 接受新名称，`client` 维度显示 `Xiaomi MiMo / MiMo Code`。该客户端默认关闭；CC-Switch router 归因仍仅覆盖 Claude 系列与 Codex，不适用于 mimocode。
- 启用与首次采集。`token-usage config set clients.mimocode.enabled true` 启用客户端；首次执行 `token-usage collect all --client mimocode` 回补存量历史；daemon 运行中需 `token-usage daemon restart` 以加载新配置段并开始实时监控。

### 修复
- 仪表板的范围选区改为按标签页记忆。选区从 `localStorage` 迁到 `sessionStorage`：刷新同一标签页保留所选范围，新开的页面一律回到 Today 默认。此前选区按源永久持久，之后打开的页面会恢复陈旧的字面日期——昨天的 Today，且无预设按钮回亮。此行为与文档承诺（「跨刷新记忆」）对齐；无需任何操作——旧的 `localStorage` 条目不再被读取。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
